security_recall_007.evidence: Teachers released through this process, who are not on active corrective discipline as found within their district personnel file, shall be given the first right of interview for positions for which they are qualified that become available during the six months following their release.
security_recall_007.coder_notes: Changed answer from 'no' to 'yes' as the document explicitly grants released teachers the first right of interview for available positions, which constitutes a callback right.

security_rif_criterion_008.answer: Program and staffing needs, and relative qualifications; least seniority as tie-breaker
security_rif_criterion_008.evidence: decisions as to which teachers will be declared surplus shall be based on the program and staffing needs of the school, and the relative qualifications of the teaching staff to fill the available positions. If a choice must be made between two or more teachers determined by the principal to be equally well qualified for an available position, the teacher with the least seniority in the District will be declared surplus.
security_rif_criterion_008.coder_notes: Updated evidence to include Section 16.4.3 regarding the tie-breaker criterion (least seniority) to fully support the coded answer.

security_probation_length_009.evidence: Provisional Contract Teacher shall mean all regularly assigned teachers working half-time or more each day who have not yet completed three continuous years of contract employment as a teacher in Granite School District.

security_tenure_rules_010.evidence: Except as otherwise specifically provided in this Agreement, regular contract teachers doing satisfactory work will be continued in employment on a year-to-year basis until they retire.

security_certification_011.evidence: Before reporting for duty, teachers employed under this Agreement shall comply with all necessary licensure and/or endorsement requirements of the Utah State Board of Education. The licenses specified above must be registered with the Human Resources within thirty days following the beginning date of employment.
